content='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] in (1, 5, 9)), None)
    col_sep = next((j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] in (1, 5, 9)), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        first, second = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)] for x, y in zip(first, second)]
    first = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
    second = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)] for x, y in zip(first, second)]
'''
